verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export feature, no bulk download, and no open-format export of machines, notebooks, or account data. SSH root access lets a user copy files out manually, but that is a user-side workaround. Snapshots and custom templates are internal backups that stay on the platform, and "Cancel anytime" concerns billing rather than exporting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
